title: VP Sales
company_summary: Growth stage B2B software company, Series B, about 120 people, backed by venture capital.
description:

The company sells to mid-market finance teams. The role is based in Washington, DC, with travel about 30 percent of the time. The previous sales leader scaled the team from 5 to 12; the next step is to roughly double it within 18 months.
